title: Halad Night
address: Venue details will be shared with ticket holders before the event.
description:
💛 लग्न खोटं, पण हळदीचा थाट खरा! 💛

Get ready for London’s first Marathi Fake Wedding – Halad Night!

Experience all the madness of a Maharashtrian wedding with a live DJ, Marathi bangers, traditional outfits, नाच-गाणी and भरपूर धमाल!

No actual wedding, no वर-वधू, just immaculate wedding vibes! 😉

Get your traditional outfits ready and bring your friends along for an unforgettable night!

Join our exclusive WhatsApp group for ticket announcements, venue details and all the exciting updates.

लग्न कोणाचंही नसू दे, हळदीला मात्र सगळ्यांनी यायचं! 💛
